statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-92386: a remote HTTP server can set a cookie whose name and value make curl write a Netscape cookie jar line longer than curl's own line-length limit for reading cookie jars, so a later curl run that loads that jar silently stops parsing at that line and ignores all valid cookies after it (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92386.html). It affects the curl tool and libcurl from 8.7.0 to 8.22.0 and was fixed in curl 8.23.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/445aa87e13f91c94bc742f54343a2eac924e1765. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. The fix raises the line buffer used when loading a cookie jar from MAX_COOKIE_LINE (5000) to MAX_COOKIE_LINE + 48 (5048). In the cookie jar loading code of the static libcurl.a shipped in curl-static, on x86_64 and aarch64, the constant passed as that limit is 5000 in every build before 8.23.0-r0 and 5048 in 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, so 8.23.0-r0 is the first fixed build.
